summary.text: Claire Valdez is the Democratic and Working Families Party nominee in the open NY-7 race. A Texas native who moved to New York City in 2015, she worked at Columbia University, became a union unit chair with UAW Local 2110, and was elected to the New York State Assembly (District 37) in 2024. She describes herself as a democratic socialist and is running on labor organizing, universal rent control, Medicare for All, and abolishing ICE.

paragraphs.text: Originally from Lubbock, Texas (born 1989, per Wikipedia); moved to New York City in 2015 to pursue a career as a visual artist, according to a New York Daily News profile. Holds a BFA from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, per Wikipedia.
Took an administrative job at Columbia University, where she became active in her union, United Auto Workers Local 2110.

Worked as a union organizer and served on the bargaining committee of UAW Local 2110 at Columbia University; elected Unit Chair in 2022 to represent about 500 coworkers, and took part in the effort to elect reform candidates to UAW leadership, according to her Assembly biography.
Joined the New York City chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America in 2019, per Wikipedia; her campaign website describes her as a "proud democratic socialist."

Won the June 2024 Democratic primary for New York State Assembly District 37 over Johanna Carmona and incumbent Juan Ardila, and the November 2024 general election; took office January 1, 2025. The district includes Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Maspeth, and Ridgewood.
Assembly committee assignments for 2025-2026: Alcoholism and Drug Abuse; Cities; Social Services; Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development; Transportation.

Announced her campaign for Congress in January 2026 after Rep. Nydia Velázquez announced her retirement, and won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary over Antonio Reynoso, Julie Won, and Vichal Kumar.
Endorsed in her 2026 congressional campaign by U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders, NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani, the Justice Democrats, and NYC-DSA.
Lives in Ridgewood, Queens, according to her Assembly biography.
